description: Expected verdicts (docs/contract.md section 8) for pairs of files in evals/. Derived by hand from the spec. Item sets and per-item names come from the files (evalfile / fileEvidence). codes are the reason codes in order; measures are the reasons that carry a measure, in order, d rounded to 6 decimals (compare with |delta| <= 5e-7); hint is the first reason's hint; recompute is the aggregate recomputed on the shared items of each side (|delta| <= 1e-9).
